cmsSystems.support: Open-source software developed by the WordPress project and supported by the WordPress community. Licensed under GPL. Hosting is available through many hosting companies.
cmsSystems.technology: Server: PHP. Database: MySQL or MariaDB. Client side: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Common web servers include Apache and Nginx.
capabilities: Thousands of themes for customizing website appearance.
Thousands of plugins for adding features.
Built-in blogging and page publishing tools.
Custom post types and content management.
REST API for external applications and integrations.
limitations: Requires hosting and ongoing maintenance for self-hosted installations.
Plugins and themes can introduce security vulnerabilities.
Updates may cause compatibility problems between plugins and themes.
Advanced customization may require PHP and web development knowledge.

cmsSystems.support: Commercial hosted e-commerce platform developed and operated by Shopify Inc. It is a subscription-based service that includes website hosting and platform maintenance.
cmsSystems.technology: Hosted cloud platform with a proprietary server and database infrastructure. Storefronts use HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify's Liquid templating language. Supports APIs and integrations.
capabilities: Online store creation and product management.
Built-in shopping cart and checkout system.
App Store for adding additional features.
limitations: Requires a paid subscription for most full store functionality.
Transaction and payment processing fees may apply.
Some advanced features require paid third-party applications.
Less control over server infrastructure than self-hosted CMS platforms.
Moving a store to another platform may require significant data migration.

cmsSystems.support: Commercial hosted website-building and CMS platform developed and operated by Wix.com Ltd. Offers free and paid plans with hosting included.
cmsSystems.technology: Proprietary cloud-based platform. Client side uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Wix development tools support JavaScript and TypeScript, with managed Node.js backend environments for supported site types. Database and hosting infrastructure are managed by Wix.
capabilities: Wix App Market for adding extensions and integrations.
E-commerce, appointment booking, and business management tools.
limitations: Less control over server infrastructure and backend configuration.
Advanced development may require learning Wix-specific tools and APIs.
Some applications and business features require paid plans.
Moving a website to another hosting platform can be difficult.
Some advanced customizations are restricted by the platform.

cmsSystems.support: Commercial hosted website-building and CMS platform developed and operated by Squarespace, Inc. Subscription plans include hosting, maintenance, and security.
cmsSystems.technology: Proprietary cloud-hosted platform. Client side uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Server-side processing, databases, and hosting infrastructure are managed by Squarespace rather than exposed to customers.
capabilities: Visual website editor with customizable layouts.
limitations: Requires a paid subscription for most full functionality.
Less flexibility for advanced server-side programming.
Fewer customization options than open-source platforms such as WordPress and Drupal.
Some integrations and advanced features may require additional services.
Moving a website to another platform may require rebuilding certain features.

cmsSystems.support: Free, open-source CMS developed by the Drupal community and supported by the Drupal Association. Licensed under GPL. Hosting is provided by independent hosting companies.
cmsSystems.technology: Server: PHP. Database: MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, or SQLite. Web servers include Apache and Nginx. Client side uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
capabilities: Thousands of contributed modules and extensions.
Advanced content types and structured content management.
Suitable for large and complex websites.
limitations: Steeper learning curve than many visual website builders.
Advanced customization often requires PHP and development knowledge.
Configuration and maintenance can be complex.
Module and version compatibility must be managed.
Hosting, updates, and ongoing security maintenance require attention.
